title: First signal
prompt:
Warm-up. Implement `running_average(xs)` so it returns a list where element *i* is the mean of `xs[0..i]`.

RL agents constantly track averages of noisy rewards, so this tiny function will come back again and again.

Press **Run** to see the plot, then **Check** to verify.
hints: Keep a running total as you loop over xs.
After adding xs[i] to the total, the mean so far is total / (i + 1).
total = 0; out = []; for i, x in enumerate(xs): total += x; out.append(total / (i + 1))
